Second , there are quite a number of unexpected problems happening all over the world , such as natural disasters , and novel virus turmoil . This proves that the longer people live , the more they will encounter difficulties they cannot control on their own . As a result , it will be rare to find tranquil moments in their daily lives in such disastrous conditions . The last reason is that people never appreciate their precious lives , unless they utterly notice that the clock is ticking . To make the most of every moment , it is so much easier for people to have a short intense life , rather than long and calm one , which might unintentionally mislead that people they have tons of times left . For these reasons , I support the idea that a short but intense life is the better option in most cases .
